introduction: Follow the storm druid's burnt-tree evidence, Chauseis's remote exchange, Ahanz's hunt and the adventurer's one reward choice. The barbarian's mask and Asus's soup are services. Exact current materials prepare an offering; acceptance records its outcome. New progress requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: This area spans several separate roads, forests, settlements, tomb approaches and travel pockets. Discovery does not mean every path or giver is accessible. Follow each contact's actual route and native shared doors; these independent requests are not one mandatory journey across every room.

ASK druid about hello, hi, dark, moor or moors for burnt-tree leads. He accepts the exact ember from a burnt tree and declares a 20 platinum reward before leaving. An ember can also come from remote fireplace or hearth stock. Supplied exact evidence fits; this is not proof that you identified the burner, saved a forest or learned every keyword.

ASK barbarian about feathers or craft. His mask needs four separate exact eagle feathers together and 10 platinum. The four local eagle placements each declare feather stock with a shared cap of four. Carry all four loose; one feather, another bird's feather, worn feathers or the mask reward do not complete the service. Its mixed item-and-coin payment still needs accounting qualification before active use.

Chauseis exchanges the exact heart of Bel, orb of unmaking and mystic runed stone tablet together for the declared Wisdom scroll. Heart and orb have remote limited sources; no active declared tablet supply was found. The scroll's native type does not establish a Wisdom gain from reading. Her ambient prayers are not ASK objectives. Her separate epic Wisdom training has a normal boot binding but refuses purchases while accounting is active.

ASK ahanz about kraken. He accepts the exact heads of Princess Aventi and Prince Itneva together, rewards an unfinished wand and leaves. Matching supplied heads fit without your own kills. Ahanz's own head is not an offering. The unfinished wand is a component, distinct from the finished combat wand.

ASK fallen about tomb or mystic for the foreign mystical-key lead. The actual exact key comes from a separate Surface mystic exchange of four different lockets and a book. Matching supplied keys or an already-open route can provide access where native rules allow. Hearing the lead, recovering a local locket, holding the key and opening the tomb are different facts; no personal mystic receipt is required by the adventurer's item recipes.

ASK adventurer about priest, mage or warrior and choose ONE five-item bundle. Mage: skin of the shadow eel + tight green cloak + foggy visor + shadowy chest plate + purple robe of stars. Warrior: skin + cloak + earring of congealed blood + chest plate + misty blue dragon scale armor. Priest: skin + cloak + helm of light + mask of hatred + foggy visor. Materials shown below describe alternatives, not a requirement to gather all nine kinds.

The adventurer gives the matching unfinished handle, chest piece or crown shell plus a glowing ring, then leaves. These three alternatives count as one story outcome; asking three class keywords is not three completions. His rescue and Aceralde-defeat remarks do not establish personal rescue, kill or class requirements in the actual recipes. Equipped tower gear must be carried loose for an offering.

The wise gnomish cosmomancer near Torrhan owns four separate finishing services in Mini Zones: unfinished handle, crown shell, chest piece or wand + one exact pulsating sphere + three exact large mithril ores makes the corresponding staff, crown, platemail or wand. The strange being's sphere exchange needs six distinct plane essences. Those remote services retain their own journal ownership. Local component acceptance does not prove finished gear, sphere gathering, ore mining or matching branch lineage.

ASK asus about soup or fishing. One exact large hairy crab and one exact large shrimp together make TWO copies of the declared shrimp-and-hairy-crab bisque. Fishing can produce these species, and supplied exact fish also fit. Eating soup, holding same-name bisque or personally catching fish is not the accepted cooking receipt. The Fiord tent is reached through its actual Surface tent portal.

Six native PUSH switches alter shared blocked routes around the narrow path, overturned wagon, rubble and crypt. Exact keys and fixed sunwell, crack, tent and moonwell portals also affect access. Another player's prior opening can help. No switch press, key possession or travel description is an additional story completion.

ASK feliusius about quest, map, abandon or resign for his separate generated mission service. Its ASK/kill assignments and fees use the native mission log, not these static turn-ins. This area is excluded as a generated mission target. Mission refund settlement and an explicit journal bridge still need qualification. Crew hiring at the tent also needs a payment continuation fix before any new credit is attached.

Current exact loose custody is preparation; worn, held, nested, spent or handed-away materials do not satisfy those rows. Gifts fit without personal first-recovery history, and reward possession is not acceptance. Four stories contribute achievements and potential dailies under this area's reset mode; a giver who leaves after acceptance still needs a qualified later return and fresh materials. The mask and soup remain services. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting; limited stock and shared access govern actual availability.
